ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure, quadrilateral PQRS is a trapezoid, P is at the lower left, Q is at the lower right, S is at the upper left, and R is at an upper, somewhat middle position. There are arrows in the same direction on the upper side SR and the lower side PQ, indicating SR ∥ PQ. Reasoning: Let ∠PQR = x. The problem gives ∠SPQ = 2∠PQR = 2x, and ∠RSP = 2∠SPQ = 4x. Because SR ∥ PQ, line PS intersects two parallel lines, so the same-side interior angles ∠RSP and ∠SPQ are supplementary, that is, 4x + 2x = 180°. Therefore 6x = 180°, x = 30°. Also because SR ∥ PQ, line QR intersects two parallel lines, so ∠QRS and ∠PQR are supplementary, ∠QRS = 180° - 30° = 150°. The problem also gives ∠QRS = k × ∠PQR, so k = 150/30 = 5.

raw_record.question_text: In trapezium $P Q R S$, $\angle R S P = 2 \times \angle S P Q$ and $\angle S P Q = 2 \times \angle P Q R$. Also $\angle Q R S = k \times \angle P Q R$. What is the value of $k$?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the diagram shows trapezium PQRS with P at bottom left, Q at bottom right, S above P, R above the middle, and arrow marks indicating SR is parallel to PQ. Let ∠PQR = x. From the text, ∠SPQ = 2x and ∠RSP = 2∠SPQ = 4x. Since SR ∥ PQ, the consecutive interior angles on transversal PS are supplementary, so ∠RSP + ∠SPQ = 180°. Thus 4x + 2x = 180°, giving x = 30°. Again using SR ∥ PQ, the consecutive interior angles on transversal QR satisfy ∠QRS + ∠PQR = 180°, so ∠QRS = 150°. Since ∠QRS = k∠PQR, k = 150/30 = 5.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中四边形 PQRS 是一个梯形，P 在左下方，Q 在右下方，S 在左上方，R 在上方偏中间位置。上边 SR 和下边 PQ 上都有同向箭头，表示 SR ∥ PQ。

推理：设 ∠PQR = x。题目给出 ∠SPQ = 2∠PQR = 2x，并且 ∠RSP = 2∠SPQ = 4x。因为 SR ∥ PQ，直线 PS 截两条平行线，所以同旁内角 ∠RSP 与 ∠SPQ 互补，即 4x + 2x = 180°。因此 6x = 180°，x = 30°。再因为 SR ∥ PQ，直线 QR 截两条平行线，所以 ∠QRS 与 ∠PQR 互补，∠QRS = 180° - 30° = 150°。题目又给出 ∠QRS = k × ∠PQR，所以 k = 150/30 = 5。
